newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine banks' assets at 1.76 trln pesos in Sep.
newsitem.headline: Philippine banks' assets at 1.76 trln pesos in Sep.

text.p: The total assets of the Philippine commercial banking system reached 1.761 trillion pesos at the end of September 1996, a 2.0 percent increase from the month-ago level of 1.726 trillion pesos, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.

The increase in assets of 50 commercial banks was brought about mainly by a 3.5 percent expansion in loan portfolios to 1.098 trillion pesos and a 2.2 percent growth in investment accounts to 286.7 billion pesos, the statement said.
The Central Bank said funds for operations came from the 3.4 percent hike in deposits to 1.046 trillion pesos at the end of September and a 2.7 percent rise in borrowings to 250.9 billion pesos.
